Settings for TCPS fitting

Source: R/Tcps.R
TcpsArgs.Rd

Holds parameters controlling [fitTcps()]. Create with [createTcpsArgs()].

The `prior` and `control` fields are Cyclops objects and cannot be round-tripped through JSON. If `toJson()` is called on a `TcpsArgs` object, those fields are omitted and must be re-supplied when recreating the object.

Super class

AbstractSerializableSettings -> TcpsArgs

Public fields

prior

Cyclops prior specification (`cyclopsPrior`), or `NULL` for default.

control

Cyclops control specification (`cyclopsControl`), or `NULL` for default.

excludedCovariateConceptIds

Concept IDs to exclude from covariate construction.

includedCovariateConceptIds

Concept IDs to include (empty = all).

maxCohortSizeForFitting

Maximum persons per arm for fitting; 0 = no limit.

seed

RNG seed for downsampling reproducibility.

TcpsArgs$new()

Construct from named arguments or a JSON string.

Usage

TcpsArgs$new(
  prior = NULL,
  control = NULL,
  excludedCovariateConceptIds = integer(0),
  includedCovariateConceptIds = integer(0),
  maxCohortSizeForFitting = 250000L,
  seed = 1L,
  json = NULL
)

Arguments

prior, control, excludedCovariateConceptIds, includedCovariateConceptIds

See factory.

maxCohortSizeForFitting, seed

See factory.

json

JSON string from `toJson()`. `prior` and `control` are not restored from JSON; supply them again via [createTcpsArgs()].

TcpsArgs$toJson()

Serialise to JSON (prior and control fields are omitted).
